name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted peer-to-peer WebRTC video meetings in the browser with screen sharing, chat, whiteboard and recording.

alerts.message: HTTPS is required; browsers block camera and microphone access on a plain HTTP URL.
Rooms are open to anyone with the URL by default. Set HOST_PROTECTED=true and HOST_USERS to require a login, and set TURN_SERVER_* to your own TURN server for participants behind strict NATs.
